title: Login gagal masuk dashboard: cookie _legacy tak dibaca + skema URL ganda di verifySession
description: Gejala: submit login sukses (tak ada error di UI/log) tapi tak masuk dashboard; di browser hanya ada 1 cookie Appwrite (yang non-Secure _legacy) padahal ada 2. Root cause: (1) app jalan di HTTP polos, browser menolak cookie a_session_<proj> yang ber-flag Secure dan hanya menyimpan varian a_session_<proj>_legacy; (2) proxy.ts:10 & verifySession.ts:8 hanya membaca nama TANPA _legacy -> session dianggap tak ada -> route guard memantulkan balik ke /login diam-diam; (3) verifySession.ts:18 memakai https://${APPWRITE_URL} padahal APPWRITE_URL sudah mengandung skema http:// -> URL invalid (bug laten). Fix: baca kedua nama cookie (primer + _legacy), samakan skema URL (bare ${APPWRITE_URL}), dan set cookie token secure=true HANYA di production (dev HTTP).
acceptance_criteria: Login di dev (HTTP) berhasil masuk dashboard; middleware & verifySession membaca cookie _legacy; verifySession URL tidak lagi dobel-skema; cookie token secure kondisional per NODE_ENV
close_reason: Diselesaikan: modul appwriteSession (owner identitas sesi — kedua nama cookie incl. _legacy, base URL, X-Appwrite-Project, primitive request terautentikasi, fetchAccount, mintJWT+dedup, tokenCookieOptions secure-per-env). proxy.ts & verifySession.ts jadi thin caller. Bug _legacy + skema URL ganda (https://${APPWRITE_URL}) diperbaiki. Vitest + 13 unit test hijau. biome/tsc/next build lolos.

title: proxy.ts: gate data + mint & forward JWT (ADR 0001)
description: Implementasi auth-proxy §4.1. proxy.ts Node runtime, export default function proxy(). Rewrite /api/proxy/* ke Spring Boot http://192.168.1.211:8080 + attach Bearer server-side. Dua cookie: sesi Appwrite terenkripsi (JWE, sumber kebenaran) + token (JWT cached, httpOnly). Hot path decode exp zero-network; cold path mint via POST /v1/account/jwt; dedup Map ~5s. 4 HARDENING WAJIB: pin Node runtime; try/catch fail-safe redirect /login (JANGAN throw 500); hapus cookie token saat logout; refresh buffer 30s + mint duration:3600. Ini single point of failure semua trafik API - review & test paling ketat.
acceptance_criteria: Semua /api/proxy/* ter-forward dengan Bearer; hot path tanpa network; error apapun -> redirect /login bukan 500; cookie token terhapus saat logout
close_reason: proxy.ts: gate data + mint/forward JWT, 4 hardening, hot/cold path

title: Koreksi ADR-0001 & CONTEXT-MAP: kode = cookie-forwarding, bukan JWE-decrypt
description: ADR-0001 & CONTEXT-MAP ### Identity bridge menulis proxy.ts men-decrypt sesi JWE (compactDecrypt) sebelum mint JWT (pola mail-fe). Realita kode: TIDAK ada JWE/jose di dependencies; proxy.ts hanya meneruskan mentah Cookie: a_session_X=<value> ke POST /v1/account/jwt (cookie-forwarding). Juga 'dua cookie' di dokumen (sesi + token) beda dari dua cookie Appwrite yang teramati (a_session_X Secure + _legacy). Perlu koreksi dokumen agar reviewer arsitektur berikutnya tak tersesat, dan tambah istilah 'Appwrite Session module' ke glossary CONTEXT-MAP.
acceptance_criteria: ADR-0001 mencerminkan cookie-forwarding + hardening runtime tetap relevan; CONTEXT-MAP ### Identity bridge dikoreksi; istilah Appwrite Session module ada di Glossary
close_reason: ADR-0001 & CONTEXT-MAP dikoreksi ke cookie-forwarding; 'two Appwrite session cookies' + _legacy didokumentasikan; istilah Appwrite Session module ditambah ke Glossary

title: Modul Appwrite Session: konsolidasi identitas sesi (deepening)
description: Deepening opportunity dari /improve-codebase-architecture. Problem: pengetahuan 'apa itu sesi Appwrite' terduplikasi tanpa lokalitas di proxy.ts & verifySession.ts — 3 konstanta identik (APPWRITE_URL, APPWRITE_PROJECT, SESSION_COOKIE) dideklarasi ulang, dengan penanganan URL divergen (bare vs https://) dan nama cookie salah (tanpa _legacy) di kedua tempat. Ini penyebab struktural bug kepegawaian-fe-yor. Solusi: satu modul lib/auth/appwriteSession yang memiliki nama cookie (termasuk _legacy), base URL, header project, primitive request Appwrite ter-otentikasi, plus operasi fetchAccount() & mintJWT()+mintCache, dan tokenCookieOptions() (secure per-env). Seam: readSession(get) menerima fungsi lookup yang disuntik pemanggil (murni, tak impor next/server maupun next/headers). proxy.ts & verifySession.ts jadi pemanggil tipis.
design: Model=cookie-forwarding (bukan JWE-decrypt; ADR-0001 dikoreksi). Deployment=dev HTTP/prod HTTPS (secure kondisional). Cakupan=Sesi+Appwrite penuh (deletion test: cookie names/base URL/auth-primitive muncul lagi di 2 file bila dihapus). Seam=inject get(name)=>string|undefined (2 adapter nyata: request.cookies.get & (await cookies()).get).
acceptance_criteria: Satu deklarasi cookie name/base URL/project di seluruh app; proxy.ts & verifySession.ts memanggil modul; readSession diuji unit dengan Map palsu (primer hilang->jatuh ke _legacy); fetchAccount/mintJWT diuji dengan fetch di-stub tanpa menjalankan middleware
close_reason: Diselesaikan: modul appwriteSession (owner identitas sesi — kedua nama cookie incl. _legacy, base URL, X-Appwrite-Project, primitive request terautentikasi, fetchAccount, mintJWT+dedup, tokenCookieOptions secure-per-env). proxy.ts & verifySession.ts jadi thin caller. Bug _legacy + skema URL ganda (https://${APPWRITE_URL}) diperbaiki. Vitest + 13 unit test hijau. biome/tsc/next build lolos.

title: Split CONTEXT.md into CONTEXT-MAP.md (thick core) + docs/context/master.md (thin delta)
description: CONTEXT.md is a single Auth+Master-scoped file (253 lines, ~30 resolved decisions). Future grilling adds kepegawaian, cuti, penggajian, laporan, sistem — each contributes comparable bulk, so the single file will 'explode'. Adopt the setup-matt-pocock-skills multi-context convention: a root CONTEXT-MAP.md holding the shared/core context (cross-module conventions every module reuses) + a pointer table, plus one on-demand per-module context under docs/context/<modul>.md holding only that module's DELTA (entity taxonomy, FK graph, per-entity quirks). Layout chosen: docs/context/<modul>.md (NOT pocock-literal src/<context>/, because this FE is organized per-layer not per-bounded-context). Granularity: thick core + thin delta. DESIGN.md stays concern-based §1-19 for now (separate backlog issue if needed). 'riwayat' module placement deferred — noted as open question in the map. Consumer skills (improve-codebase-architecture, diagnose, tdd, grill-with-docs) read CONTEXT-MAP.md first per pocock domain.md.
design: Partition rule: pattern/mechanism -> core; entity-instance data (names/counts/FK/per-entity config) -> module delta. Mixed sections (list-screen, RBAC, endpoint conventions, dashboard, app-shell) keep the pattern in core and push only the '17 entities'/FK-example specifics into master.md.
acceptance_criteria: CONTEXT-MAP.md exists at root with shared/core context + module pointer table + open questions (riwayat). docs/context/master.md holds only Master delta. Old CONTEXT.md removed or reduced to a redirect. DESIGN.md source-doc reference updated to point at the map. No decision content lost (verify section-by-section against old CONTEXT.md). Update CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md domain-docs pointer to note multi-context.
close_reason: Split CONTEXT.md into CONTEXT-MAP.md (thick shared core, 30 cross-module sections) + docs/context/master.md (thin Master delta). CONTEXT.md reduced to redirect stub with section->location table. DESIGN.md source-doc pointers updated. Verified section-by-section, no decision lost (restored Tree entities + Parent picker generic patterns to core). CLAUDE/AGENTS have no CONTEXT pointer, so nothing to update there.

value: Auth Appwrite kepegawaian-fe = cookie-forwarding, BUKAN JWE-decrypt. Appwrite set 2 cookie sesi: a_session_<projectId> (Secure;SameSite=None) + a_session_<projectId>_legacy (fallback non-Secure). Di HTTP browser buang yang Secure, simpan _legacy saja -> reader harus coba dua-duanya (primary dulu). Baca hanya nama primary = bug login-bounce senyap. Identitas sesi dimiliki modul src/lib/auth/appwriteSession.ts; proxy.ts & verifySession.ts thin caller. tokenCookieOptions: secure hanya di production (dev HTTP).
